fusions.name: Lulling Note
fusions.desc: Sings a note into the first enemy it meets for 3 damage, with a 35% chance of leaving it [Slowed] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Lullaby
fusions.desc: Sings out in a ring, dealing 9 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and stunning each for 1.5 seconds.

fusions.name: Drifting Rest
fusions.desc: Restores 18 health to you. Its healing rises 8% for every 10% of your health already gone (max 40%).

fusions.name: Riding the Current
fusions.desc: The moment your stamina runs out, you regain 3 stamina a second for 4 seconds. Once every 20 seconds.
